learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to design unit operations from the three fields of process engineering (chemical, thermal, mechanical) by applying subject-specific methods and heuristics to apparatus in an industrial environment.
Understand the scientific principles of the aforementioned unit operations.
Design a process consisting of unit operations at the level of block flow diagrams.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the principle of unit operations; Flow diagrams according to EN 10628
Chemical Process Engineering: Equilibrium and kinetics, fundamentals of catalysis, ideal reactors, real reactors, residence time distribution, heat balances, selection criteria for reactors
Thermal Process Engineering: Application of thermodynamic principles, distillation and rectification, extraction, absorption, crystallization, drying
Mechanical Process Engineering: Particles and disperse material systems; Mixing: Homogeneity and mixing quality; Separation: Sedimentation; Centrifugation; Screening; Size Reduction: Agglomeration
Selected experiments on pilot plant apparatus: Reactors, extraction centrifuge, sieve centrifuge
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module exam and the laboratory internship with an internship report. The grade is weighted according to credit points.
